changes.title: Event Streams Replays API (/v1/Replays, beta feature api.eventstreams.replay) removed from the spec (breaking)

source.quote: Remove the Replays API (`/v1/Replays`, beta feature `api.eventstreams.replay`); the feature was never GA and is being sunset **(breaking change)**

changes.title: twiml_session resource deprecated in favour of the new twiml_process resource; twiml_session will be removed in a future release

source.quote: Add `twiml_process` resource alongside `twiml_session` (`twiml_session` is deprecated and will be removed in a future release)

changes.title: IAM POST /v1/actions/post_login webhook payload changed: user_context removed, acr/completed_factors replaced by authentication_context, request_context and ip_address now required

source.quote: Removed user_context from the POST /v1/actions/post_login (PostLoginActionRequest) webhook payload; the login email is read from authentication_context.methods

changes.title: Memory API UpdateStore, UpdateTraitGroup and UpdateDataMapping now reject an empty body with 400 (behaviour change)

source.quote: `UpdateStore`, `UpdateTraitGroup`, and `UpdateDataMapping` now require a body with at least one property. An empty `{}` gets a 400.

changes.title: Destinations: GET removed from the method enum for webhook destination type config options

source.quote: Removed `GET` from the `method` enum on the `webhook` destination type's config options

changes.title: Unified Audiences API renamed to Cohorts; audienceId replaced by cohortId in OperationPayload/OperationResult, Get* operations renamed Fetch*, header-based-versioning specs removed, storeType MEMORA changed to TWILIO (preview/hidden API, unsure impact)

source.quote: Removed the deprecated header-based-versioning unified specs, consolidating audiences onto the path-based `api.twilio.com/v1` surface.

changes.title: Data-ingress v1: 31 paths removed and re-added with lower-camel-case path parameter names (e.g. {SyncId} to {syncId}); likely a spec-casing change but check generated clients (unsure)
Webhooks API: GET /v1/Webhooks/Settings list items now documented as full Setting (adds auth, signature, connection, edgeZones) (response shape change, unsure)

source.quote: `GET /v1/Webhooks/Settings` now documents each item as the full `Setting` rather than `SettingSummary`, adding `auth`, `signature`, `connection` and `edgeZones` to the list response.

changes.title: twilio-node 6.0.0 raises minimum Node.js to 20; Node versions below 20 are no longer supported

source.quote: Upgrade to Node.js >= 20 before updating to `twilio` 6.x.x
